title: Nell Finds a Big Job
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Nell spots a big branch stuck in the stream.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering above a narrow garden stream, looking at a thick fallen branch blocking it.

pages.text: The branch blocks the little stream.
pages.illustration: Water pooling up behind the branch, unable to flow past it in the stream.

pages.text: Nell tries to push the branch, but it will not shift.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee pressing against the branch with her front legs, the branch not moving at all.

pages.text: Nell can not shift it alone.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee resting on top of the branch, looking tired, the branch still firmly stuck.

pages.text: Nell calls for Pip and Moss to help.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee calling out towards Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog in the distance.

pages.text: Pip and Moss come to the stream.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog arriving at the edge of the stream.

pages.text: All three push the branch at once.
pages.illustration: Nell, Pip and Moss all pushing against the branch together from different sides.

pages.text: The branch slips free of the stream.
pages.illustration: The branch sliding away from the stream, water beginning to flow past it again.

pages.text: The little stream runs fast and free.
pages.illustration: The stream flowing freely and quickly now that the branch is clear.

pages.text: Nell is glad to have such good help.
pages.illustration: Nell, Pip and Moss standing together by the clear, flowing stream, all looking pleased.
